user.title: Select Device
user.description: Select your LEDnetWF device from the list below.

confirm.title: Add Device
confirm.description:
Found device **{name}**

- Address: `{address}`
- Product ID: `{product_id}`
- Firmware: `{fw_version}`

Would you like to test the connection by flashing the light?

error.cannot_connect: The Home Assistant server wasn't able to establish a reliable connection to your device. Ensure it is powered on and in range, then try again.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported LEDnetWF devices found. Make sure your device is powered on.

data.default_transition: Default fade time when none is given (seconds; blank keeps the device default)
data.white_channel: White channel (auto / present / none: none for RGB-only strings, white comes from the colour wheel)

set_segment_colors.name: Set segment colours
set_segment_colors.description: Set a separate colour on each segment of an IOTBT segment device (addressable string), in string order. Up to 61 segments.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: List of [R, G, B] values (0-255), one per segment. [0, 0, 0] leaves a segment dark.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Overall brightness 0-255, applied to every segment.
